blocks.text: Upon discovery of a data breach, the incident commander must simultaneously notify Legal, IT Security, and the PR team within 1 hour of discovery.

IT Security must isolate all affected systems immediately upon notification. Legal must determine whether regulatory reporting is required. Under GDPR, notification to the relevant data protection authority must occur within 72 hours of discovery. Under CCPA, notification to affected individuals must occur within 45 days.
PR prepares a customer-facing communication. Legal must review and approve the customer communication before it is sent to any external party.
If more than 500 individuals are affected by the breach, the Data Protection Authority (DPA) must also be notified in addition to any standard regulatory notifications.

messages.text: Clarification from Legal: the GDPR 72-hour notification window runs from the time we confirm the breach, not from first detection of the anomaly. Please update incident runbooks accordingly.
